evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 8.9 → 10.1 → 18.2 → 24.3 ppm, versus ~5-8 ppm baseline after purge
Tube pressure drifting upward 3.00 → 3.07 → 3.14 → 3.21 Torr at constant Ar setpoint
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure/O2 rise is not a flow change
Temperature holding at 750 °C after initial overshoot; heater control nominal

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend; an Ar-flow step or brief pump-isolation (rate-of-rise) test would distinguish air ingress through a seal from exhaust restriction.
